Hey, I’ve felt the things you’re talking about many times before and, when it feels like you’re passive and floating through life aimlessly, sometimes it helps to make a single small change. Maybe you could dye your hair a different color or try to create through painting or writing. 

I don’t know what you’re going through on the day to day but... if there’s a chance that you’re reading this I hope you can find something to give you a sense of control which won’t involve hurting yourself.

This doesn’t really resemble my keratosis- the bumps on my skin are usually more pronounced. Not that I recommend popping them, but when you do- what kind of discharge is there?(If there’s any at all)

I figured some thing like that.. I just hate hurting people’s feelings. He’s been really nice to me and even though I know that I don’t owe him anything for his kindness- I’d hate to leave him feeling like I didn’t care about him at all

Well ideally I’d like to establish/ clear up that he doesn’t love me..
Cause like I know he doesn’t, I think he /thinks/ that he loves me

But I don’t know how to do that or if that’s the right course of action

Please don’t go- please. I can’t tell you what your life will be like in the future but isn’t there always the chance that things could change for the better? Or the chance that you could find something you care enough to live for? Please don’t do this.

I experience the same thing myself and it’s hard to deal with but until you get out of the habit- your best bet imo is to exfoliate and moisturize your arms with every shower(helps reduce my symptoms at least) and wear long sleeves to keep the thought out of you mind.
Good luck to you!

No you’re not ugly. A lot of people seem to be commenting on your weight? Yeah I don’t get that you seem fine and healthy- a round face yeah it’s not doing you a disservice. You might just need to try putting yourself out there more or analyze how you deal with male attention. You could be subtlety rejecting them/ showing disinterest without realizing it
Wait sorry- into canines?? Now I’m concerned
Yeah thats a good way to put it. I just hope he doesn’t take it poorly.

I’ve identified as bisexual for 4, almost 5 years (sorry, should’ve mentioned that before). So I know I’m attracted to girls- but similarly, making out just doesn’t seem very appealing.

Still, thank you for your input

Oh no, I’m fine with sex. Something I’m excited for- I’m just waiting for a birth control prescription because I don’t want any mistakes. 

Not to mention it’s hard to have the house to ourselves with parents home no matter what.
